source: script v1 (Claude Doc 采访八百壮士的一天 · 剧本 v1, 25 Nov 2026) with the changes in scripts/sihang/voice/make_lines.py

title.en: A Day Interviewing the Eight Hundred

speakers.ji: 记者 (the camera, never seen; standard Mandarin)
speakers.mc: 满仓 (演绎人物, 19, 湖北通城)
speakers.lb: 老班长 (演绎人物, 河南)
speakers.xj: 谢晋元 (中校团附, 广东蕉岭; sourced quotes only)
speakers.yr: 杨瑞符 (营长, 天津; sourced quote only)

lines.en: They say there are eight hundred men in here.

screens.en: They say there are eight hundred men in here.

lines.pic: Frame 0: lamp light, soldiers hauling grain sacks to the windows; the camera pans along them.

lines.en: I counted three times: four hundred and twenty.
lines.pic: The head count lands on three helmets: 418, 419, 420.
lines.tts: [whispers, flat] 我数了三遍——四百二十。

lines.en: How many of you are here?

screens.en: How many of you are here?

lines.en: Eight hundred!
lines.pic: 满仓 with a sack on his shoulder, helmet a size too big.

lines.en: ...To outsiders, we all say eight hundred.

screens.en: ...To outsiders, we all say eight hundred.

lines.emo: lower, a glance round, a small grin
lines.pic: The title: a 号外 front page slams on.

lines.zh: 我叫满仓。这回，仓真是满的。
lines.en: I'm Mancang, 'full barn'. This time the barn really is full.

screens.en: This time the barn really is full.

lines.emo: shy, pleased with his own joke
lines.pic: The unit's clipping card over the live picture, then his banner; the sacks piled to the ceiling.

lines.en: Which one is Commander Xie?

lines.zh: 我也不认得。我才来三个月。
lines.en: I don't know him either. I've only been here three months.

screens.en: I've only been here three months.

lines.en: Only one man in this building is sitting down.

screens.en: Only one man in this building is sitting down.

lines.pic: The camera pans to the one man seated at a crate, writing by a lamp.

lines.en: Commander, what are you writing?

lines.zh: 晋元决心殉国，誓不轻易撤退，亦不作片刻偷生之计。
lines.en: I am resolved to die for my country. I swear not to retreat lightly, nor to seek a moment's survival.

screens.en: I am resolved to die for
my country. I swear not to
retreat lightly, nor to seek a moment's survival.

lines.emo: calm, even, as he writes; no heroics
lines.pic: His banner; the seal 原话 · 遗书. He folds it, hands it to a runner, looks at the lens, nods.

lines.en: Reporter, what's that shining over there?

screens.en: Reporter, what's that shining over there?

lines.pic: Through the window slit: neon across the Suzhou Creek, sixty metres away.

lines.en: Neon lights.
...Shanghai is so bright.
lines.pic: His face half warm lamp, half cold neon. Hold two seconds.

lines.en: Reporter, you can write, can't you?

screens.en: Reporter, you can write, can't you?

lines.en: To whom?
lines.pic: A pencil and a warehouse goods slip come into the frame.

lines.zh: 我娘。……就写：娘，儿在上海。住的洋楼，高得很。
lines.en: My ma. ...Write: Ma, I'm in Shanghai. I live in a foreign-style building, very tall.

screens.en: ...Write: Ma, I'm in Shanghai. I live in

lines.pic: The letter's first line appears on the goods slip.

lines.en: The rest, I'll think about.
lines.pic: The REC clock runs to 27 Oct 08:20; the neon goes out, daylight.

lines.en: East side. Ready.
lines.pic: First the south bank: roofs and balconies full of people; a blackboard. Then the attack: the camera ducks behind the sacks.

lines.en: That one's ours.
That one's ours too.
...That one's theirs.
lines.pic: His hand presses the camera down. A sack over her leaks wheat.

lines.en: ...Thank you.
lines.pic: Silence. Then cheering from across the river.

lines.en: They're... cheering for us?
What time is the shift change?

screens.en: What time is the shift change?

lines.zh: 换班？四百二十个人，守一栋楼……
lines.en: Shift change? Four hundred and twenty men, holding one building...

screens.zh: 四百二十个人，守一栋楼……
screens.en: Four hundred and twenty men, holding one building...

lines.en: Eight hundred.
Right, eight hundred. ...Eight hundred don't change shifts either.
lines.pic: Seal: four days and nights, no relief. Shell dust whites the lens out.

lines.en: They're digging at the foot of the wall. To blow the building.

screens.en: They're digging at the foot of the wall. To blow the building.

lines.pic: Digging under the wall. A young soldier, back to us, ties grenades on and steps onto the sill.

lines.en: You...
lines.pic: The window is empty. A blast below; dust drifts in. Hold. White words: 陈树生，二十一岁。 满仓 takes off his helmet. Black.

lines.zh: 你们就说有八百人，决不可说只有一营人。
lines.en: Say there are eight hundred men. Never say there is only one battalion.

screens.en: Say there are eight hundred men.
Never say there is only one battalion.

lines.emo: gruff, low, to the wounded on the stretchers
lines.pic: The wounded are carried out at the back. His banner; the seal 原话.

lines.en: So that's Commander Xie.
lines.pic: The companies stand in rows. The battalion commander brings forward the man who was writing.

lines.en: We live or die with this last position.

screens.en: We live or die with this last position.

lines.pic: The seal 原话 · 10月28日晚. Paper is handed down the rows; pencils.

lines.en: Shall we go on?
lines.pic: From here no effects: one slow push.

lines.zh: 写……顿顿有粮吃，粮食堆到房顶。
lines.en: Write... there's grain at every meal. Grain piled up to the roof.

screens.en: Write... there's grain at every meal. Grain

lines.pic: Behind him the sack wall, shot through, leaking.

lines.zh: 我们人多，有八百人。莫挂念。
lines.en: There are a lot of us, eight hundred. Don't worry.

screens.en: There are a lot of us, eight

lines.en: ...Eight hundred?
Write eight hundred. Ma will rest easy when she hears it.

screens.en: will rest easy when she hears it.

lines.zh: 他娘不识字。信到了，村里先生念给她听。
lines.en: His mother can't read. When it comes, the village teacher reads it to her.

screens.zh: 信到了，村里先生念给她听。
screens.en: When it comes, the village teacher reads it to her.

lines.pic: 满仓 presses a thumbprint in lamp soot. The push ends on three lines and the print.

lines.en: Reporter eats first.
lines.pic: A rope through the wall hole: sacks of bread, biscuits, tins, medicine. He holds a tin out to the lens.

lines.en: ...No pull tab?
City folk.
lines.pic: He opens it with his bayonet.

lines.en: Eight hundred lone soldiers hold Sihang to the death.

screens.en: Eight hundred lone soldiers hold Sihang to the death.

lines.pic: A newspaper from under the sacks: the front page close up.

lines.en: ...We're in the paper? Can my ma see it?
The village teacher can.

lines.zh: 旗。对岸一个女学生送来的。
lines.en: A flag. A schoolgirl brought it over from the other bank.

screens.zh: 旗。对岸一个女学生送来的。
screens.en: A flag. A schoolgirl brought it over from the other bank.

lines.pic: A roll of cloth. The seal. Then dawn on the roof: the flag's shadow slides over upturned faces; the south bank roars; a blackboard.

lines.en: A window, courtesy of the enemy.

screens.en: A window, courtesy of the enemy.

lines.pic: Searchlights, shells. The west wall is holed; he sets the machine gun in the new hole.

lines.en: Reporter! Add one more line to the letter!

screens.en: Reporter! Add one more line to the letter!

lines.en: Add what?
When the fighting's done, I'm going home to cut the rice!

screens.en: When the fighting's done, I'm going

lines.pic: The fourth line, shaky. The battery: 7%. Midnight: the field telephone rings.

lines.en: Orders: the whole battalion withdraws into the Settlement!

screens.en: Orders: the whole battalion withdraws into the Settlement!

lines.en: Withdraw? Didn't we say live or die here?

screens.en: Withdraw? Didn't we say live or die here?

lines.en: It's an order.
lines.pic: 谢晋元 looks back at the building. A searchlight whites the lens out.

lines.en: Head down!
lines.pic: The bridge under searchlights; they run in batches; his hand presses the camera down.

lines.en: Reporter. The letter.
lines.pic: South side. Rifles are piled up; he holds his a second, then lets go. The goods slip: four lines and a thumbprint.

lines.en: I've got it.
lines.pic: The battery: 2%, the red lamp blinking.

lines.en: Hey! How many were really in there?
lines.emo: shouting from behind the cordon, a newsman
lines.pic: The camera looks back: 满仓, 老班长, the tired line of men.

lines.en: Eight hundred.
lines.pic: The battery dies. Black. The end slate: five white lines.
lines.tts: [quiet, sure, after a breath] 八百。
